description: This file is a shell script that processes build logs, extracting embedded 'trash' directories based on specific start and end markers, and decompressing their contents after decoding from base64. It includes functions for error reporting, pattern matching, and handling CRLF line endings in logs.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits the script.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads input lines to find a line indicating the start of a trash directory entry, extracting the test name upon success.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines until it finds the end marker for the embedded trash directory, outputting contained lines and handling unexpected input.
